cover_letter:
Hi Econodata team!

I was super excited to find the AI Growth Hacker role at Econodata. Operating right at the intersection of technology, Generative AI, Python data automations, and B2B SaaS growth is exactly what I do best!

Over the past 8+ years, I’ve built B2B growth and marketing systems. At Meu Barzin, I used Python scripts, n8n webhooks, SQL databases (Supabase), and LLMs to build a B2B acquisition funnel from scratch, capturing 500+ qualified leads on a lean budget. At Munzner, I built an automated multi-channel nurture sequence generating 10,000+ visits and R$ 50k in revenue.

My background combines 2.5 years of Engineering (UTFPR/UFPR) with a B.A. in Philosophy (UFPR), giving me complete technical autonomy to write Python scripts, run SQL queries, test A/B hypotheses, and build scalable growth engines.

I’d love to connect and discuss how we can leverage AI agents and rapid experimentation to accelerate Econodata’s funnel even further!

Best,
Kevin Augusto Vieira

form_answers.question: How do you leverage Generative AI and Python automation scripts for B2B lead generation?
form_answers.answer: I build automated growth pipelines combining Python scripts for API/webhook data enrichment (n8n, SQL databases) and Generative AI (Claude, ChatGPT) for personalized message creation, content pipelines, and A/B prompt testing.
